plugins.name: aio-epub-translate
plugins.description: Translate EPUB books into literary Vietnamese end-to-end — upload, pre-translation analysis, chapter translation with consistency checks, quality review, and bilingual export.

plugins.name: aio-youtube
plugins.description: Search YouTube and extract video transcripts using yt-dlp.

plugins.name: aio-gherkin-refine
plugins.description: Comprehensive BDD field guide — writes and reviews Gherkin with expert quality. Includes Example Mapping, 3 Amigos, anti-patterns catalog, and declarative style guide.

plugins.name: aio-bun-fullstack-setup
plugins.description: Bootstrap a Bun fullstack project in one shot — single-port API + frontend, Vite dev proxy, monorepo layout, and Docker config. Skips files you already have.

plugins.name: aio-mental-models
plugins.description: Reach better decisions faster — picks the right mental model (first principles, inversion, second-order, opportunity cost, …) and walks you through applying it to your problem.

plugins.name: aio-threat-models
plugins.description: Pick and apply the right threat-modeling framework — STRIDE, LINDDUN, PASTA, MITRE ATT&CK/ATLAS, Attack Trees, and 22 more — for security, privacy, and AI/ML risk analysis.

plugins.name: aio-monitoring-observability
plugins.description: Monitoring and observability strategy, implementation, and troubleshooting. Metrics design (Golden Signals, RED/USE), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), alerting, SLOs, dashboards, log aggregation, and tool selection. Includes 7 automation scripts and production-ready templates.

plugins.name: aio-ios-device-debug
plugins.description: Debug iOS apps on physical devices. Build, install, launch, capture logs, pull crash reports, and analyze crashes from the terminal.

plugins.name: aio-xstate
plugins.description: Build XState v5 state machines the right way — design-first planning, params-first typing, and canonical actor patterns for TypeScript and React, with anti-god-machine enforcement.

plugins.name: aio-golang-mastery
plugins.description: Write and lint idiomatic Go end-to-end — a 7-tool lint chain (build, vet, golangci-lint, govulncheck, nilaway, deadcode, race) plus reference-grade patterns for concurrency, errors, generics, gRPC, and production hardening.

plugins.name: aio-tui
plugins.description: Build production-grade Go TUIs on the charmbracelet v2 stack (bubbletea/v2 + lipgloss/v2) — Elm architecture, restrained styling, and elite patterns for async rendering, layout geometry, mouse hit-testing, caching, and live refresh.

plugins.name: aio-browser-cookie
plugins.description: Extract browser cookies with rookiepy and reuse them for authenticated requests or Netscape cookie exports.

plugins.name: aio-claude-toolkit
plugins.description: Sharpen Claude Code — patch and recompile Claude's binary for custom use cases (control channels, agent-as-a-service, custom tooling), capture this session's workflow as a reusable skill, consolidate memory, and ship feedback to the marketplace.

plugins.name: aio-devops
plugins.description: GitHub, GitLab, and git worktree workflows in one toolkit — manage repos, PRs, MRs, pipelines, and parallel branches without juggling CLIs.

plugins.name: aio-design-system
plugins.description: Design and ship UI with confidence — UI/UX guidance, neobrutalism design system bootstrapping, and SaaS analytics dashboard design (chart selection, anti-pattern checks, a11y, storytelling).

plugins.name: aio-diagramming
plugins.description: Generate shareable Mermaid URLs and auto-build Grafana dashboard diagrams from your codebase — diagrams that travel well, without leaving the terminal.

plugins.name: aio-research
plugins.description: Run structured 10-phase research workflows and stand up RAG pipelines on Qdrant — go from a topic to a queryable knowledge base.

plugins.name: aio-codeflow
plugins.description: Understand, plan, debug, and review code as one coordinated workflow — codebase discovery, dependency mapping, implementation planning, root-cause debugging, and pre-merge review.

plugins.name: aio-saas-tools
plugins.description: Drive Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace (Drive/Gmail/Calendar/Sheets/Docs), Tanca HR, and X/Twitter from your terminal — one CLI per service, no context switching.

plugins.name: aio-watermill-kit
plugins.description: Build event-driven Go apps with Watermill — Router, middleware, Pub/Sub, CQRS, and integrations for Kafka, AMQP, NATS, Redis Streams, and SQL.

plugins.name: aio-kanban
plugins.description: Track AI-agent work in a markdown kanban board committed to the repo — index board with per-task files, an auto-dispatch monitor that spawns sub-agents for matching tasks, and an optional Go terminal UI (aiokan) for vim/mouse board steering.

plugins.name: aio-software-architect
plugins.description: Make architecture decisions with confidence — a deep pattern reference and a 5-step decision workflow covering cloud patterns, resilience, data, DDD, and distributed systems.

plugins.name: aio-starrocks
plugins.description: Design StarRocks tables and tune slow queries — partitioning, bucketing, sort keys, and PK tuning, plus EXPLAIN/Query Profile reading and concrete tuning recipes.

plugins.name: aio-visual-diff
plugins.description: Verify AI-built UI against design via measurement-driven diff — extracts computed CSS and bounding boxes through Chrome DevTools MCP, diffs against Figma reference or a frozen baseline, and feeds numerical deltas back to the agent. No screenshot eyeballing.

plugins.name: aio-html-interactive
plugins.description: Bridge Claude to a browser UI in real time. Solves the AI-event-loop gap with a frozen Bun + Vue3 + Tailwind scaffold: browser events become Monitor-tool notifications (server emits MSG:: lines to stdout), Claude pushes broadcast over WebSocket. Claude only edits the APP REGION; runtime, protocol, and vendor blocks stay frozen.

plugins.name: aio-image
plugins.description: Remove image backgrounds using RMBG-2.0 alpha matting with despill — works on any image (renders, photos, screenshots). Pairs with the flat-magenta chroma-key technique: render subject on #FF00FF with any image gen engine, then matte for a clean PNG RGBA cutout.

plugins.name: aio-code-review
plugins.description: Google's engineering code-review playbook — turns Claude into a thoughtful reviewer or a disciplined CL author. The 8 things every reviewer looks for (design/functionality/complexity/tests/naming/comments/style/docs), the LGTM threshold ("improves code health, not perfection"), how to write courteous comments, how to handle pushback, how to write good CL descriptions, and how to keep CLs small. Source: github.com/google/eng-practices (CC-BY 3.0).
